title: How AI Trading Led Me to Build My First iOS App
author: valeriibaidak
selftext:
I was using an AI agent for trading that monitored the market 24/7 and notified me whenever an important signal appeared.

The problem was simple: if the signal came in the middle of the night, a regular push notification was easy to miss.

That made me think: why can’t an AI agent set an actual alarm when something really matters?

That’s how **VeliAlert** was born.

Through MCP, an AI agent can now:  
🔔 Set alarms  
📲 Send push notifications  
🚨 Trigger SOS notifications

I originally built it for trading, but later realized it’s just as useful for coding, automations, and other AI agents.
